result.detail: Entry module is irq_ctrl_cov_tb; harness module irq_ctrl_cov_harness is in the same testbench file, so only irq_ctrl.v is measured. The N=32 instance is a deliberate, disclosed choice: it verifies the upper end of the RTL's stated parameter range, not just padding coverage. If reviewers prefer N=8 only, remove h32 and the toggle ceiling is bounded by the 26 constant bits listed in the report. If the platform run shows a toggle shortfall caused only by the listed constant bits, the exclusion decision belongs to the designer and reviewer (escalation path starts at verification.dynamic.coverage.code.senior), not to this seat. Independent review is still required after the coverage.read evidence is recorded.
